name: Skyline Piru San Diego
description: The Skyline Pirus (SLP) are a primarily African-American Blood/Piru gang based in the Skyline neighborhood of southeastern San Diego. Open to other ethnicities including Polynesian/Pacific Islanders, Asians, and Mexican-Americans, they are considered by law enforcement to be the largest Blood gang in San Diego. The gang was founded by former members of San Diego's East Side Hanging Gang (EHG) and a relocated Piru member from Compton, California.
